about: An experienced attorney with the Law Offices of David S. Lin, David S. Lin represents local business clients in California, i.e. Los Angeles as well as San Francisco and international business clients from China, Hong Kong and Taiwan. His practice focuses mainly on business litigation, including breach of contract, business disputes and commercial partnership and shareholder disputes. With over 30 years of legal experience, Mr. Lin represents businesses of all sizes and individuals in business litigation, contracts and business dispute matters; insurance claims and bad faith litigation; real estate litigation and construction defect cases as well as catastrophic personal injury cases.

Mr. Lin is fluent in English and proficient in Mandarin Chinese. He attended Boston University School of Law, earning his Juris Doctor in 1991. While studying to become an attorney, he was president of the National Asian Pacific American Law Student Association at his school. He is a graduate of Cornell University, with a B.A. in Government in 1988

Licensed to practice in all superior courts in California, he is also admitted to practice before the United States Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit, the California Supreme Court, the United States District Court for the Eastern District of California, the United States District Court for the Southern District of California and the United States District Court for the Northern District of California.

Mr. Lin is passionate about helping impoverished children around the world and does so through his volunteer charity work with World Vision International. He is a member of the American Bar Association, The State Bar of California, the Consumer Attorneys Association of Los Angeles, the American Board of Trial Advocates, the Los Angeles County Bar Association. For over a decade, Pasadena Magazine named him a Top Attorney in Pasadena, California.
